mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Residential construction starts exceeding 1,250 thousand units in the latest monthly report signal robust housing market activity, which correlates with strong consumer spending and positive equity returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months when HOUST exceeds 1250, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in non-farm payrolls and declining unemployment rate indicates a tightening labor market that boosts consumer confidence and spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect between PAYEMS growth and UNRATE decline fails to produce positive returns in more than 55% of instances, or the interaction term's coefficient is not significant (p>0.05) in a regression over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 3.0%, the Federal Reserve is expected to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as higher rates pressure equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained expansion in real GDP (GDPC1) over the past quarter indicates strong economic growth, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of quarters when GDPC1 growth is positive, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production index below 100 (relative to 2017=100) signals a contraction in manufacturing output, which correlates with weakening economic activity and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in retail sales (RSAFS) and residential construction (HOUST) indicates strong consumer and housing demand, which together drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction between RSAFS growth and HOUST growth fails to produce positive returns in more than 55% of instances, or the interaction term's coefficient is not significant (p>0.05) in a regression over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of low unemployment (UNRATE < 3.5%), the labor market is tight, leading to wage pressures and potential inflation, which triggers Federal Reserve rate hikes and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 3.5, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
